accepts.implementation_commit_title: Prospective participation availability watch and capture path

scope.applies_to: every distinct raw version observed PROSPECTIVELY by the availability watch
scope.does_not_apply_to: historical final files, which are schema and reproducibility references only and are never prospective vintage evidence

requirements.text: identical bytes must not create another raw blob
changed bytes must create a new immutable blob
never delete an earlier distinct vintage because a later vintage exists
preserve first-seen and every observation manifest row

requirements.enforced_by: availability.assert_retention_policy (refuses any durability but commit_raw for a watched source)

requirements.text: no historical backfill masquerading as prospective vintage evidence
requirements.enforced_by: availability.assert_no_orphan_blobs + first-seen write-once + no Last-Modified narrowing on either source

accepted_cost.measured_2026_09_08: one distinct snapshot pair costs 3.4 MB committed: pbp_participation 2.9 MB gzipped from 49,094,943 raw bytes, snap_counts 0.5 MB from 2,401,193.
accepted_cost.projection_note: Growth depends on how often upstream rewrites the files in season, which is NOT known and which the watch will measure. Weekly rewrites over an 18-week season is roughly +61 MB; daily is roughly +430 MB. These are projections, not measurements, and neither is a commitment.
accepted_cost.rationale_recorded_from_owner: Preserve every distinct prospectively observed raw version. Dropping bytes is the irreversible choice.

what_this_decision_does_NOT_do: It does NOT authorize predictive use of either source.
It does NOT change the receiving architecture.
It does NOT discharge any T-90 target or any capture kind.
It does NOT change G0A, which remains 11/12.
It does NOT authorize NFL-1, which remains NOT AUTHORIZED.
revision_rule: Changing this policy is an owner decision and requires a superseding artifact naming this decision_id. A retention change that would DELETE an already-captured distinct vintage is irreversible and may not be executed on the strength of this file alone.
